meta.name: prisma-driver-adapter-implementation
meta.description: Required reference for Prisma v7 driver adapter work. Use when implementing or modifying adapters, adding database drivers, or touching SqlDriverAdapter/Transaction interfaces. Contains critical contract details not inferable from code examples — including the transaction lifecycle protocol, error mapping requirements, and verification checklist. Existing implementations do not replace this skill.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 Prisma 7 的适配器规范来写或修改数据库驱动代码:事务结束只清理资源、不直接发结束指令;把驱动报错转成 Prisma 能认的错误;最后给出验证清单。
howto.when: 当你让它开发或修改某个数据库的适配器、接入新数据库驱动,或改动 SqlDriverAdapter/Transaction 这类内部接口时,它会按这份规范处理。

say.text: 按这个技能为 PostgreSQL 写一个 Prisma 7 驱动适配器。
say.note: Claude 会按接口规范生成实现代码。

say.text: 我改了 SqlDriverAdapter 的接口,先查这个技能的契约。
say.note: 它会用事务生命周期协议检查你的改动。

say.text: 给我 Prisma 7 适配器的错误映射和验证清单。
say.note: 它会整理驱动错误与验证要点。

howto.what_en: Claude writes or edits adapter code per Prisma 7 driver-adapter interfaces: commit/rollback only releases resources (no SQL), errors map to Prisma's expected kinds, and a verification checklist is included.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to implement or modify a driver adapter, add a new database driver, or touch SqlDriverAdapter/Transaction interfaces.

say_en.text: Write a Prisma 7 driver adapter for PostgreSQL using this skill.
say_en.note: Claude generates code from the interface definitions and implementation steps.

say_en.text: Check this skill's contract before editing the transaction interface.
say_en.note: It validates commit/rollback against the lifecycle protocol.

say_en.text: Give me the error-mapping and verification checklist for Prisma 7 adapters.
say_en.note: Claude maps driver errors to Prisma kinds and lists checks.
